purpose: LRM 4.6.4.6: one noise function on two branches is one source whose contributions add as phasors

oracle.derivation: One white_noise n of 1e-18 A^2/Hz, contributed as 2*n on out-0 and -3*n on x-0. Conductances: out has g1 = 1 mS to 0, R1 = 1k to in (a small-signal short; noisy=0, so its 4kT/R stays out) and g3 = 1 mS to x; x has g2 = 2 mS to 0. Y = [[3e-3, -1e-3], [-1e-3, 3e-3]], det 8e-6, so Z_oo = 375 and Z_ox = 125 ohm, real. One source: H = 2*375 - 3*125 = 375 ohm, onoise = 375e-9 = 3.75e-7 V/sqrt(Hz), flat. Independent rows would give 8.385e-7, one source with the sign dropped 1.125e-6. oct 1 from 1k to 4k: 1k, 2k, 4k (8k is past 4k*(1 + 2e-3)).
